about: Osteoporosis, a qualifying T-score and a prior fragility fracture support review. The 4 mg oncology infusion does not treat osteoporosis. Treatment is suitable and no current osteoporosis medicine is recorded from any service.
The record shows osteoporosis, and alendronate (Fosamax) is supplied every four weeks up to the end, so a bone-strengthening medicine is in place.
The hospital gave the annual 5 mg osteoporosis infusion seven months before the record ended.
Possible finding: the patient reports a hospital osteoporosis infusion, but its date is unknown and current cover cannot be established.
A dated palliative care plan rules out all osteoporosis drug treatment despite documented osteoporosis and a qualifying T-score.
